author: PostOakLabs
description: Applies a table you declare. It ships no table, and is not guidance from any audit firm or standard-setter. The sample size is only as defensible as the table. From a control frequency, a declared population size, a declared population hash, a period in days and a caller-supplied policy table keyed by frequency, it returns the sample size from the matching row, whether the declared population falls inside the expected range for that frequency (a mismatch is flagged, never corrected), and a deterministic integer start offset derived from the population hash and evenly spread selected indices. A missing table, a missing or duplicated frequency row, an invalid row or a sample size above the population is refused with an explicit code. No randomness and no clock.

control_frequency.description: A frequency id that matches exactly one policy_table row, for example monthly

population_size.description: Number of instances of the control in the period; integer of at least 1

population_hash.description: Hash of the sorted population extract, declared by the caller; seeds the start offset

period_days.description: Length of the testing period in days; integer of at least 1, echoed in the output

policy_table.description: Caller-declared rows of frequency, min_population, max_population and sample_size (integers); the node ships no table

mcp_tool_definition.description: Applies a table you declare: from a control frequency, a declared population and your policy table, returns the sample size and a deterministic selection of indices across the whole population, and flags a population outside the range declared for that frequency. Ships no table and is not audit guidance. Refuses a missing table, a missing or wrong-typed frequency or hash, a missing frequency row, a sample larger than the population or larger than 100000. Zero network calls, zero PII.

control_frequency.description: Frequency id matching one policy_table row

population_size.description: Instances of the control in the period

population_hash.description: Declared hash of the sorted population extract

policy_table.description: Caller-declared rows: frequency, min_population, max_population, sample_size

mcp_tool_definition.name: plan_control_frequency_sample

outcome.description: planned, or refused when the input cannot be planned

refusal_reasons.description: Explicit refusal codes, empty when planned

control_frequency.description: The declared frequency, null when none was given

population_size.description: The declared population size, null when not a valid integer

period_days.description: The declared period in days, null when not a valid integer

frequency_row.description: The policy table row used, null when refused

sample_size.description: Sample size taken from the table row, null when refused

within_expected_range.description: Whether the population lies inside the row's expected range, null when refused

start_offset.description: fold(population_hash) mod population_size, in 0..population_size-1, null when refused

selected_indices.description: Zero-based indices floor((start_offset + i * population_size) / sample_size), unique and in range, empty when refused

title: Plan Control Frequency Sample
